chapter.title: Watching
chapter.subtitle: The APIs your app actually calls

caption: APIs change under your app, and it breaks **quietly**.
say: Every app depends on APIs it doesn't control. When one changes, things break quietly, and someone spends a day finding out why.

caption: The watcher is a **Terse durable actor**.
say: Agent Smith watches the APIs your app actually calls. This watcher is a Terse durable actor. It checks our supplier every few seconds and remembers exactly what its responses look like.

caption: The supplier ships a new version.
say: Now the supplier ships a new version. Stock isn't one number any more. It's on hand and reserved.

caption: Noticed within seconds. **Nobody pressed a button.**
say: The watcher notices within seconds and opens a case. Nobody pressed a button.

caption: **getStock** reads the field that was removed.
say: First question: does this actually affect us? Agent Smith reads the app's code and finds the one function that reads the removed field.

caption: Fields the app doesn't read are **set aside**.
say: The same update also removed a warehouse code and added a restock date. The app reads neither, so Agent Smith checks them, shows why, and sets them aside.

chapter.title: Fixed and proved
chapter.subtitle: A fixer and a verifier, over Agent Relay

caption: A separate verifier owns the tests, over **Agent Relay**.
say: A repair agent writes a fix in a sandbox. A separate verifier, over Agent Relay, owns the tests. The fixer can't touch them.

caption: 7 on hand − 5 reserved = **2** to sell.
say: The same test command fails before and passes after. Seven on hand, five reserved: two to sell. The verifier's hidden checks pass too, including never selling stock we don't have.

caption: A **deliberately bad patch**, sent back.
say: To show the verifier really checks, here's a deliberately bad patch. It forgets that stock can't go below zero, so the verifier sends it back.

chapter.title: You decide
chapter.subtitle: A person approves. Nothing merges by itself.

caption: A tested PR, waiting for **a person**.
say: Then it stops and hands you a tested pull request. A person approves. Nothing merges or deploys by itself.

caption: Killed and restarted: **state intact**.
say: Every case lives in a Terse durable actor. Kill the server, and nothing is lost: the case and the watcher's memory survive, the watcher is re-armed, and it carries on counting.

caption: Stay current with the APIs you depend on.
say: Your app stays up to date with the APIs it depends on. Agent Smith.
